agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py Case.get_cases(): the condition `elif not (token.match(T.Keyword, 'END')): mode = None` incorrectly reset parsing mode for every non-END token, breaking CASE/WHEN/THEN/ELSE condition/value classification used by reindent and aligned_indent formatters. Changed to `elif token.match(T.Keyword, 'END'): mode = None` so mode only resets at the closing END keyword. Verified via manual script that sqlparse.format with reindent=True and reindent_aligned=True now produce correct CASE statement formatting, including the BETWEEN variant. Removed the temporary verification script from the workspace.
